heading: World Trade Center Health Program Fund

children.heading: In general
children.text: There is established a fund to be known as the World Trade Center Health Program Fund (referred to in this section as the “Fund”).

children.heading: Funding
children.text: Out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, there shall be deposited into the Fund for fiscal year 2016 and each subsequent fiscal year through fiscal year 2090—
the Federal share, consisting of an amount equal to—
for fiscal year 2016, $330,000,000;
for fiscal year 2017, $345,610,000;
for fiscal year 2018, $380,000,000;
for fiscal year 2019, $440,000,000;
for fiscal year 2020, $485,000,000;
for fiscal year 2021, $501,000,000;
for fiscal year 2022, $518,000,000;
for fiscal year 2023, $535,000,000;
for fiscal year 2024, $552,000,000;
for fiscal year 2025, $570,000,000;
for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2040—
the amount determined under this subparagraph for the previous fiscal year multiplied by 1.07; multiplied by
the ratio of—
the total number of individuals enrolled in the WTC Program on July 1 of such previous fiscal year; to
the total number of individuals so enrolled on July 1 of the fiscal year prior to such previous fiscal year; and

for each subsequent fiscal year through fiscal year 2090, the amount specified under this subparagraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year; plus
the New York City share, consisting of the amount contributed under the contract under section 300mm–41(d) of this title.

children.heading: In general
children.text: No funds may be disbursed from the Fund unless New York City has entered into a contract with the WTC Program Administrator under section 300mm–41(d)(1) of this title.

children.heading: Breach of contract
children.text: In the case of a failure to pay the amount so required under the contract—
the amount is recoverable under subparagraph (E)(ii) of such section;
such failure shall not affect the disbursement of amounts from the Fund; and
the Federal share described in paragraph (2)(A) shall not be increased by the amount so unpaid.

children.heading: Amounts from prior fiscal years
children.text: Amounts that were deposited, or identified for deposit, into the Fund for any fiscal year under paragraph (2), as such paragraph was in effect on the day before December 18, 2015, that were not expended in carrying out this subchapter for any such fiscal year, shall remain deposited, or be deposited, as the case may be, into the Fund.

children.heading: Amounts to remain available until expended
children.text: Amounts deposited into the Fund under this subsection, including amounts deposited under paragraph (2) as in effect on the day before December 18, 2015, for a fiscal year shall remain available, for the purposes described in this subchapter, until expended for such fiscal year and any subsequent fiscal year through fiscal year 2090.

tree.heading: Mandatory funds for monitoring, initial health evaluations, treatment, and claims processing

children.heading: In general
children.text: The amounts deposited into the Fund under subsection (a)(2) shall be available, without further appropriation, consistent with paragraph (2) and subsection (c), to carry out part B and sections 300mm(e), 300mm(f), 300mm–1(a), 300mm–1(b), 300mm–2, 300mm–3, 300mm–4(a)(1), 300mm–4(a)(2), 300mm–4(c), 300mm–51, and 300mm–52 of this title.

children.heading: Limitation on mandatory funding
children.text: This subchapter does not establish any Federal obligation for payment of amounts in excess of the amounts available from the Fund for such purpose or as available from the World Trade Center Health Program Supplemental Fund under section 300mm–62 of this title, the World Trade Center Health Program Special Fund under section 300mm–63 of this title, or the World Trade Center Health Program Fund for Certain WTC Responders at the Pentagon and Shanksville, Pennsylvania under section 300mm–64 of this title.

children.heading: Limitation on authorization for further appropriations
children.text: This subchapter does not establish any authorization for appropriation of amounts in excess of the amounts available from the Fund under paragraph (1) or as available from the World Trade Center Health Program Supplemental Fund under section 300mm–62 of this title, the World Trade Center Health Program Special Fund under section 300mm–63 of this title, or the World Trade Center Health Program Fund for Certain WTC Responders at the Pentagon and Shanksville, Pennsylvania under section 300mm–64 of this title.

children.heading: Limitation for research cohort for emerging health impacts on youth
children.text: Notwithstanding paragraph (1), the amounts made available under such paragraph may not be used for fiscal years 2023 through 2032 to carry out subsection (c) of section 300mm–51 of this title.

tree.heading: Limits on spending for certain purposes
tree.text: Of the amounts made available under subsection (b)(1), not more than each of the following amounts may be available for each of the following purposes:

children.heading: Surviving immediate family members of firefighters
children.text: For the purposes of carrying out part B with respect to WTC responders described in section 300mm–21(a)(2)(A)(ii) of this title—
for fiscal year 2016, the amount determined for such fiscal year under subparagraph (C) 1 as in effect on the day before December 18, 2015; and

for each subsequent fiscal year, the amount specified under this paragraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year.

children.heading: WTC Health Program Scientific/Technical Advisory Committee
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out section 300mm–1(a) of this title—
for fiscal year 2016, $200,000; 2

for each subsequent fiscal year, the amount specified under this paragraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year.

children.heading: Education and outreach
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out section 300mm–2 of this title, for fiscal year 2016 and each subsequent fiscal year, $750,000.

children.heading: Uniform data collection
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out section 300mm–3 of this title and for reimbursing Data Centers (as defined in section 300mm–4(b)(2) of this title) for the costs incurred by such Centers in carrying out activities under contracts entered into under section 300mm–4(a)(2) of this title—
for fiscal year 2016, the amount determined for such fiscal year under subparagraph (C) as in effect on the day before December 18, 2015;
for fiscal year 2017, $15,000,000; and

for each subsequent fiscal year, the amount specified under this paragraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year.

children.heading: Research regarding certain health conditions
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out section 300mm–51 of this title—
for fiscal year 2016, the amount determined for such fiscal year under subparagraph (C) 1 as in effect on the day before December 18, 2015; and

for each subsequent fiscal year, the amount specified under this paragraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year.

children.heading: World Trade Center Health Registry
children.text: For the purpose of carrying out section 300mm–52 of this title—
for fiscal year 2016, the amount determined for such fiscal year under subparagraph (C) 1 as in effect on the day before December 18, 2015; and

for each subsequent fiscal year, the amount specified under this paragraph for the previous fiscal year increased by the percentage increase in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (all items; United States city average) as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with March of the previous year.
